events.title: Fresh Pasta Two Ways- North Versus South
events.description: Pasta Making Workshop Overview The great pasta divide in Italy is eggs or no eggs. Learn how to mix, sheet, cut and cook pasta fresca. Pasta tasting concludes the workshop The great pasta divide in Italy is eggs or no eggs. Refined white flour with eggs or more rustic semolina without. This hands on workshop stokes your pasta fluency. Pasta seems simple, just a few ingredients, but the simplicity is deceptive. Making fresh pasta requires the right ingredients, the right tools and the right shape
